author: Truegamer123z
quote: I came home from work eager to cause chaos just to find out it could ruin your playthrough? I played several hours of doing chores to try to unlock stealing cars feature and found out this is more like a dating sim game than the GTA I knew and loved. 0/10 for the immeasurable disappointment after a decade of loyalty to GTA Online. RIP the franchise, bring back the OG writers or Rockstar’s future is cooked.
